newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Ansett says no comment on SIA link.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Ansett says no comment on SIA link.

text.p: Ansett International said on Monday it could not comment on a newspaper article which said the airline was close to agreeing to an alliance with Air New Zealand and Singapore Airlines Ltd.
"Ansett is always exploring potential alliances with international airline companies - but I can't give you any information on the (newspaper) story," a spokesman from the airline told Reuters.
The report, in the Australian Financial Review newspaper, said senior federal government officials had been briefed about the alliance which due to be announced sometime in May.
The paper said the alliance would be similar to the alliance between Qantas Airways Ltd and British Airways Plc which sees those airlines pool resources and services.
